title: Institutionalization of AEO Procedures
summary: The concept of government body interaction has evolved from general regulatory oversight to a structured, rule-based framework for Authorized Economic Operators (AEO). This transition involves the formalization of application, rejection, and certification processes under the AEO Rules of 2024.

evolution.institutional_structure: Shift from generic government notifications to specialized AEO Center operations.
evolution.procedural_rigor: Transition from discretionary oversight to codified administrative forms (Form-Gha, Form-Nga, Form-Na).

timeline.change: Introduction of formal rejection procedures for AEO applications by the AEO Center.
Establishment of formal certification and time-extension protocols for AEO status.

অথরাইজড ইকোনমিক অপারেটর (AEO) সেন্টার

(আবেদনকারীর নাম ও ঠিকানা)

Authorized Economic Operator: This form serves as an official notification for the rejection of an application for Authorized Economic Operator status following a preliminary verification process.

The document requires the specification of reasons for the rejection of the application and is to be issued by the relevant Director General or designated official at the Authorized Economic Operator Center.
This government body is responsible for managing the application process for Authorized Economic Operator status and for communicating the results of preliminary verifications to applicants.

মহাপরিচালক/দায়িত্বপ্রাপ্ত কর্মকর্তা
অথরাইজড ইকোনমিক অপারেটর (AEO) সেন্টার

(আবেদনকারীর নাম ও ঠিকানা)

Authorized Economic Operator: This government body is responsible for issuing the Recognition Certificate for Authorized Economic Operators under the specified regulatory framework.
Recognition Certificate: This certificate formally grants Tier-1 Authorized Economic Operator status to an institution following the evaluation of an application or the fulfillment of conditions from a prior temporary certificate. The certificate remains valid for a specific duration as prescribed by the relevant rules from the date of issuance.
National Board of Revenue: The Board is the authority that issues the rules governing the recognition and operational procedures of Authorized Economic Operators.
Authorized Economic Operator (AEO) Commi: This committee holds the mandate to approve the granting of Authorized Economic Operator status to applicant institutions.
Provisional Certificate: This interim document serves as a basis for the final recognition if the applicant meets the necessary conditions for certification before the formal committee approval.

মহাপরিচালক/দায়িত্বপ্রাপ্ত কর্মকর্তা
অথরাইজড ইকোনমিক অপারেটর (AEO) সেন্টার

(প্রতিষ্ঠানের নাম, ঠিকানা, সনদ নং, তারিখ)

Authorized Economic Operator: A recognized Authorized Economic Operator (AEO) may be granted an extension of time by the Authorized Economic Operator (AEO) Center to fulfill the applicable conditions for their recognition status.
Failure to comply with the mandated conditions within the extended time frame may result in the suspension or cancellation of the entity's AEO recognition certificate.

This government body is responsible for granting extensions to AEOs for meeting regulatory compliance conditions and possesses the authority to suspend or cancel the recognition of non-compliant entities.
Authorized Economic Operator (AEO) Rules: The procedure for extending the time limit for AEOs to fulfill their recognition requirements is governed by the provisions of these rules.
